title: Litmus 2024: World’s Largest Atheist Meet in Kerala
description:
Litmus 2024 - The World's Biggest Atheist Meet which was held in God's own Country, Kerala on 12th October 2024 at the Calicut Trade Centre, Swapna Nagari, Kozhikode, Kerala. 

Across the globe, atheists and freethinkers often feel isolated. But once a year, in Kerala, thousands gather for Litmus — the world’s biggest atheist meet. Organised by esSENSE Global, Litmus is a celebration of humanism, critical thinking, rationalism, and secular values .

This year’s Litmus 2024 will be held on Saturday, October 12, at the Calicut Trade Centre, Swapna Nagari, Kozhikode. The theme is “Celebrate You” — highlighting the power of individuals to think freely, challenge dogma, and live with dignity. Expect debates, discussions, GeneOn sessions, open clinics, and even a public trial on God & Cosmology. Topics range from freethinking vs Islam, Hindutva as fascism, secularism in decline, to evolution and medical science Q&A.

From its humble beginnings in 2018 with 2,500 attendees, Litmus has grown to audiences of 10,000+, making it a historic event of global significance. It’s not just about rejecting religion — it’s about affirming science, reason, equality, and human rights.

If you’ve searched for Litmus 2024 Kozhikode, esSENSE Global atheist meet, world’s biggest atheist gathering, Kerala atheist events, or humanism in India, this video is your guide to the event.
